registrySource.name: NBA Stats CommonAllPlayers
registrySource.coverageClaim: Every row returned by NBA CommonAllPlayers with current-only disabled; independent universal historical completeness is not asserted.

fieldConventions.totals: Exact published count totals except explicit nulls for unsupported or disputed fields. MIN is source-rounded whole minutes, not exact seconds.
fieldConventions.percentages: Published rates normalized to fractions 0..1, undefined zero-attempt rate null.
fieldConventions.perGame: Source-displayed rounded averages; no count is reconstructed from these averages. Averages for a disputed corresponding total are also null.
fieldConventions.derivedFromTotals: Separately labeled values calculated only from non-null canonical counts.
fieldConventions.GS: Not present in selected StatMuse query totals tables; null throughout, even when a corroborator has values.
fieldConventions.PLUS_MINUS: Only recorded where selected source supplies it; partial-career values must use fieldCoverage coveredGames.
fieldConventions.teamAggregation: Shaq 2007-08 regular is one canonical TOT row. RealGM team components retained separately and never added again to the whole-season row.
fieldConventions.coverage: Played season aggregates only; absent playoff years are not fabricated. No game logs or shot records.
